sentences: For managing muscular pain, several options are available, depending on the severity and cause of the pain
Topical creams and ointments containing capsaicin or menthol can provide temporary relief by blocking the production of a chemical called substance P, which transmits pain signals to the brain
Over-the-counter pain relievers such as ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin) or naproxen (Aleve) can also be effective in reducing pain and inflammation
Heat or cold therapy, such as applying a warm or cold compress to the affected area, can help relax muscles and reduce pain
Physical therapy, including massage, stretching, and strengthening exercises, can also be beneficial in managing muscular pain
In some cases, prescription medications such as muscle relaxants or corticosteroid injections may be necessary to manage severe or chronic pain
